newsitem.title: UK: Horrified British butcher makes money mincemeat.
newsitem.headline: Horrified British butcher makes money mincemeat.

text.p: A British village butcher watched in horror as his day's takings turned into mincemeat before his eyes.
Barry Moore hid 840 pounds overnight in his shop mincer in rural Devon only to return in the morning to see his 70-year-old father switching on the machine for business.
"The mincer just chewed up the bills and cheques before he could turn it off," Mike Howard, who works in the shop, said on Tuesday.
"You don't expect to come in and start mincing fivers. We couldn't believe it."
The local post office swapped 540 pounds worth of bills for fresh ones. Because the village is so small, the shop simply asked customers for new cheques, Howard said.
"Everyone's been taking the mick, coming in and asking if we have any mint condition sausage." The incident happened on Saturday.
